songs.title: Barbara Allen
songs.body:

[Verse 3]

Saying [Am]haste and come to [C]my master dear

[Verse 4]

songs.title: Red River Valley
songs.body:

[Chorus]
Come and [G]sit by my side if you love me

Just re[C]member the Red River [G]Valley
And the [D]cowboy that loved you so [G]true

[Verse 2]
I've been [G]thinking a long time, my darling
Of the [C]sweet words you never would [G]say
Now a[C]las, must my fond hopes all [G]vanish
For they [A7]say you are going a[D]way

[Verse 3]
Do you [G]think of the valley you're leaving
Oh how [C]lonely and dreary 'twill [G]be

songs.body:

[Verse 2]

[Verse 3]

[Verse 4]
